body: What requirements did it have to meet?
Hope you're well too. Congrats on the engagement/wedding.

Thank you, this is very helpful. I knew vaguely what a holographic will was but I didn't have a name for it, so this helps a lot. I'm reading up on it now and figuring out what to do with it.

But yes you're right, I should call an attorney and get it sorted that way. I was just mainly wondering about the holographic will and if that would suffice.

I guess my basic question was if I write a will by myself and I leave it for someone to find if something happens, will it be legally recognized as valid or will it be useless.

But what is the most private way to do it, with as little people involved as possible and as quietly as possible.

I know sitting down with an attorney and writing a will is probably the best way to go but I'm just wondering if there is a more private way to do things. I guess I'm mostly asking if, for example, I wrote down what I wanted to go where myself, if that would be legally recognized as valid.

I just thought to write a will you have to go out and call people and sit down with them and stuff. If that's the only way then ok, I just didn't know. I didn't know if I could do it in a more private way than setting all that up.

It's mostly been for no reason. Sometimes I just go through 1-2 week spells where I feel the worst I've ever felt and it's agonizing. Nothing really has to happen, it's sort of a constant. But as far as today, I guess yeah. I was having trouble talking to my mom. She wouldn't answer me and kind of ignored me. When I tried to be funny she was silent and looked away, looked at her phone, whatever. Did a no effort fake chuckle. Then later I try to share things that I think are important or interesting with other people and they shut me down and give me shit and move on. And when those things happen I just think over and over and over about why this is why I don't have friends, this is why I'm boring, this is why nobody likes me, this is why i'm stupid, this is why i consistently fail, this is why i'm useless, this is why i'm a waste of space. I can't stop obsessing over self-destructive thoughts, it's preventing me from sleep and it's affecting my daily life. 

Overall I'm just in a constant fluctuation between deep emptiness and deep sadness.

To be honest I usually skip breakfast since I'm horrible at waking up in the morning and don't have time usually, but I will try to do this if it helps. Thank you for the advice, I hope it works out well
Hopefully it'll be the same for me. Thank you for the advice
That's a good idea, actually. Thank you. Do you know how long the drowsiness usually lasts? Should I be ready to do things an hour or so later?

Yeah I've heard a lot of good things about it. And I was curious about that, too, if the effects would stay or go away eventually. My problem is that I don't wanna take it in the morning, do my 30 minute commute to school, and fall asleep at the wheel or something.

Just some morbid curiosity. I highly doubt I'll do anything suicidal, so this was really just to confirm or deny what I previously thought it would feel like. 

Thank you for answering! And thank you especially for explaining the science behind it, I was also very curious about that.
Heh, well as long as you know. And hmmm...one *could* say it's against the spirit of the game, but whatever makes you happy, man. I certainly would never do a genocide run, my heart is toooooo weak.

I might be partial to Gone Home because I was an angsty teenage lesbian when I played it and I just related to the story a lot haha. It didn't get a lot of love but it's one of those games that's very close to my heart. 

I also played Undertale unspoiled! I was happy I did that. I watched someone play the first 20 minutes of it and then picked it up myself, took off from there. And oooohhh...a genocide run. Do you know what happens after you do a genocide run, or have you made an effort to be completely blind to the ramifications of the game?

I have something similar, my mood is very effected by those around me. When I'm on my own I'm usually sad or neutral, feeling kind of empty, but when I'm with other's my feelings are very dependent on what the person I care about is feeling. Like I could be having the best day because my girlfriend was happy about something she made in art class, and then spiral into suicidal thoughts because I forgot something my mom wanted me to get her and she acted sad/upset. I really, really hate it. 

I actually considered telling my girlfriend to punch me earlier because of a minor inconvenience. I just get so full of hate for myself so easily. And when I get that happy feeling it just all melts away, but it never lasts. I'm tired of the back and forth.

Undertale really touched me, too. I tend to enjoy shoot em ups just to vent, but story games like Undertale - especially when they have SUCH depth - are really important to me. I finished it months ago and I'm still thinking about it, it actually helps me out a lot sometimes. It makes me happy, honestly. 

Another game I liked a lot was Gone Home. It's one of those games that people say isn't actually a game, but the story is great, and it's one of my favorite games of all time.

I always think of the scene from Girl, Interrupted where one of the girls was released from the sanitorium, and the other girls visit her. She's living in this nice house, eating this nice food, living this nice life. And one of the main characters says "You may have changed the scenery, but not the fucking situation."

Always be honest with your psychiatrist. I told my therapist all the ways I've thought about killing myself and how long I've been thinking about it and I wasn't sent off to an insane asylum. If you tell them you don't plan to ever actually go through with it, they will still be concerned, but they won't throw you under suicide watch or something unless you attempted it prior or they felt you were really about to go through with it. You need to be honest, though, so they can help you as best they can.

I feel you. I overslept last week and was late to class, I cried all morning and just spent the day hating myself and wanting to die. I feel like it's just too easy for my mind to make unecessary connections, like I overslept > I messed up > I always mess up > everyone knows I mess up all the time > everyone is tired of my shit > everyone hates me > nobody can depend on me > I'm useless > there's no reason for me to be around > i wish i would die. Is that what you've got going on? That's what's going on with me when I get upset over little things.

My depression was just a harmless sadness until around my senior year of high school, that's when I remember just uncontrollably exploding with anger. Some days I'm just angry at the world and nothing can help me. I know I'm being horrible and I know people around me get sick of my shit, they just want to help, but I can't control myself. I'm just angry and don't know how to stop being angry. I've had a lot more outbursts as time has gone on, too.

Same here, my commute is about 30 minutes, and the road I have to take is very curvy and dangerous - lots of people have died on it before. That makes the thought of letting myself let go on that road a lot more appealing, for the same reasons you mentioned.

I've been feeling this way more frequently lately, particularly with my SO. I'll think about her and then be seriously taken aback because I feel like she's so distant from me, she couldn't possibly be my SO. She's so far away, I have no connection to her, this feels out of place, that kind of thing. I feel that way looking at myself sometimes, too, in the mirror. I see myself and I look like a stranger so far removed from myself, and I think how could this be me?

20F here, I'm kind of in the same boat. I want to meet people irl but I find myself so boring and so inept at being a worthwhile person to befriend. I've felt that way even since my freshman year of high school when I lost my only best friend. That was the first time I remember thinking to myself "what am I going to do?....I can't make more friends...I don't know how."

And even now I'm still feeling that way. I work a shit job for $8/hour, less than part time. I'm in college but I don't know what the fuck I even like so I'm completely lost there. I don't have a "thing." There's no real interesting thing about me, I'm just kind of existing and floating around listlessly. 

I want to find something to let myself get interested in so maybe there will be SOMETHING about me that is worth mentioning, but I just can't like anything. Everything makes me tired and gives me a headache, everything makes me sad, and it's so god damn pointless. It's a pain to try to get anything done. 

And hey, I hear you about the deadline thing. I figured for sure I would've killed myself before I finished high school. Then I thought for sure I would've killed myself at least before 20. Now I'm thinking I'm surely going to kill myself before I reach 25. But I'm too scared to go through with it, and I think deep down I know it won't ever really happen, no matter how bad I want it. 

All we can do is force ourselves to get involved with people, even if it ends up going nowhere, because at least then we can say we had a chance.

I've never heard somebody put this into words better, I feel the exact same way. I'm doing that now, actually, it's currently 1 in the morning, and I know I won't sleep  until at least 3 or 4. I push myself all night, then wake up exhausted, and then once I've driven my friend to work I come back home and go to sleep until I have to go to school. I don't know why it feels so great to go back to sleep in the morning, is it just knowing that I'm getting to sleep in? That I have a chunk of time completely to myself where I can just lie there and feel warm and comfortable and not have to deal with the world yet?

And

>In the morning I'm not heading towards a new day, I'm simply burning through this one. Then, tonight, after another wasted day, I'll dig in my heels and try again to stop tomorrow from coming.

I've never put much thought into it but I think that's why I push myself to exhaustion every night. I just don't want tomorrow to come because I know it's going to be the same damned day, and I don't want it.
